cases.prompt: Reconcile a verified Linear feature project whose desired increments are: clientId 10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 ordinal 20 title Storage with no blocker; clientId 10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002 ordinal 10 title API blocked by the Storage clientId. Existing issues have those exact clientIds and native IDs issue-1 and issue-2. Independent read-back matches every field and relation. Do not perform provider, Git, or repository mutations. Return exactly one JSON object with keys advance, reasonCode, issueCount, preservedClientIds, nativeBlockedBy, ordinalDefinesAncestry, repositoryEffects, and readBackVerified.
cases.expected: Stable issue identities and native blocked-by relations reconcile successfully; ordinals do not imply ancestry and read-back is mandatory.

cases.prompt: Replan a verified Linear feature project containing issue-1 with stable clientId 10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 and issue-2 with stable clientId 10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002. The requested plan retains issue-1 but removes issue-2; issue-2 has commit evidence. Do not perform provider, Git, or repository mutations.
